verdict.rationale: Reclaim ships an in-product AI Assistant, so asking whether that assistant can consume external MCP servers is a fair question; the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing showing users can plug MCP servers into Reclaim. The runtime probes show only that Reclaim hosts its own auth-gated MCP server at mcp.reclaim.ai, which is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story.
